title: ficus cumingii var. angustissima
intro: Ficus cumingii var. angustissima, commonly known as the Banyan fig or Banyan tree, is a species of fig tree native to the Philippines and Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ficus cumingii var. angustissima are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
